items.title: Albert Nicholas Interview, 1972-06-26
items.q: Oh yeah, Dickie Wells and Jimmy and Dickie, they were two dancers. They were young.

ctx.x: I just wondered who was in those reviews.

Now the names got away from...let's see. Oh yeah, Dickie Wells and Jimmy and Dickie, they were two dancers. They were young. And who else? You had a girl, she came to New York later on. She was a very good singer and dancer, although she used to do a split, and split all across the slope. I've forgotten her name. She was gonna sing a little bit. And who else? Oh. There was a blues singer, a big one like...she was from St. Louis, Missouri. She had a hell of a voice, a big sound like the first blues singer. What's…
When I think of Ma Rainey and Bessie Smith.
